$comment: Library of ready-made NPCs for adventure authors. Original to Emberreach. The secret is for the GM only.

npcs.name: Brannoch Tallowby
npcs.description: Round, loud and generous. His inn holds the only fire in the village that has never gone out.
npcs.secret: Pays a smuggler to keep a cellar door unlocked. He does not know what the smuggler carries.

npcs.name: Ilsabet Coalwright
npcs.description: Her cart rings with hammers and tongs. She will mend a weapon for a story as readily as for silver.
npcs.secret: She is hunting the person who ruined her old forge, and she recognizes one of the heroes' marks.

npcs.name: Brother Quill
npcs.description: Soft-spoken and ink-stained, he tends a shrine to the Ember and writes down every visitor.
npcs.secret: His ledger lists who has visited the vault below, and he has been paid to burn two pages.

npcs.name: Dacey Two-Coin
npcs.description: Quick with a smile and slower with the truth. She sells maps, rumors and the occasional unlabelled crate.
npcs.secret: Her best route runs straight through the dungeon the heroes are about to enter, and she knows where the traps are.

npcs.name: Captain Verrin Hale
npcs.description: Weathered and exhausted, with too few guards for the roads. Hires heroes quietly and pays on time.
npcs.secret: He suspects someone in his own watch is selling patrol routes to bandits.

npcs.name: Mother Sorrel
npcs.description: A herb-seller who keeps bees and grudges. Villagers fear her and visit her at night.
npcs.secret: Her salves are laced with a mild charm that makes people trust her. She means no harm by it, yet.

npcs.name: Tobiah Reedlow
npcs.description: Silent, patient and entirely unimpressed by heroes. His ferry crosses where no bridge will hold.
npcs.secret: He once carried something across at midnight that rang like a bell, and he has never told anyone.

npcs.name: Sera Ashgrove
npcs.description: Lean, sunburned and dry-humored. She reads tracks and weather like other people read signs.
npcs.secret: She was sent to see whether the heroes can be trusted with the location of a second hearth.

npcs.name: Archivist Penhallow
npcs.description: A scholar in a coat too big for them. Loves a question more than an answer, and a long answer most of all.
npcs.secret: They have forged one page in the archive to hide an embarrassing mistake, and a wrong answer follows from it.

npcs.name: Lady Corvane Ashdown
npcs.description: Gracious, exact and always one step ahead. She offers the heroes work that happens to need doing.
npcs.secret: She wants the same relic the heroes do, and plans to take it from them afterward.

npcs.name: Gorr Redhand
npcs.description: A broad man with a red-dyed glove and a hearty laugh. He taxes the road and calls it protection.
npcs.secret: He is afraid of someone higher up the chain, and a reasonable offer can turn him.

npcs.name: Little Marl
npcs.description: A twelve-year-old with big ears and a very small price. Knows who is in town and where they sleep.
npcs.secret: Is secretly paid by two factions at once.

npcs.name: Joss Kettleburn
npcs.description: Heavy-eyed and scarred, between jobs and between meals. Guards the heroes' camp for the price of a hot dinner.
npcs.secret: He used to fight for the Ashen Choir and knows their signs.

npcs.name: Wren Halloway
npcs.description: Cheerful, competitive and in all the same places the heroes are. Leaves a mess and a mocking note.
npcs.secret: Wren is working off a debt owed to Lady Ashdown and will betray the party if pressed.

npcs.name: Envoy of the Ashen Choir
npcs.description: Soot-stained robes and a polite voice. Speaks of ash as a kindness and of embers as a theft.
npcs.secret: Carries a letter sealed in black wax naming the next ember the Choir plans to put out.
